title: Falscher Stromzählerableser – Auseinandersetzung nach versuchtem Trickdiebstahl

extraction.summaryEn: A suspected distraction thief posing as a meter reader tried to rob an 86-year-old resident in his flat, then punched the 50-year-old son who confronted him and fled without stolen goods. The son suffered grazes and facial redness and declined medical treatment.
